source: Common open and machine-readable data formats. Matched against plain format tokens (e.g. 'CSV') and against the suffix of EU file-type authority URIs (e.g. http://publications.europa.eu/resource/authority/file-type/CSV -> 'CSV') that several portals emit. Open standard + machine-processable; excludes presentation/document formats (PDF, HTML, DOC) and proprietary binaries. Not sourced from data.europa.eu.
note: Used by Q27. Adjustable: add a token here to widen the set. media-type spellings are mapped to these tokens in formats.py.
